The '''Bone Yard''' is located in level 32 [[Wilderness]], and is populated by aggressive level 25 [[Skeleton|skeletons]]. It is notable for the large amounts of [[bones]] and [[big bones]] that can be found there. Due to the fast respawn rate of the bones there, the Bone Yard is an effective way for [[free-to-play]] players to train [[Prayer]], by picking up and burying the bones and big bones as they spawn.

To the south-east of the Bone Yard is the [[Bone Yard Hunter area]], which contains [[black salamander (Hunter)|black salamanders]] which can be caught with [[Hunter]].

==Transportation==
* [[Games necklace]] to the [[Corporeal Beast]], exit the lair and run north-east.
* [[Carrallanger Teleport]] to the [[Graveyard of Shadows]] and run north-east.
* [[Ring of dueling]] to [[Ferox Enclave]] and run north-east.

==Monsters==
{{LocationMonsterTableHead}}
{{LocationMonsterTableLine|name=Skeleton#Lvl 25|displayname=Skeleton|image=Skeleton (level 25, 1).png|levels=25|spawns=14}}
{{LocationMonsterTableBottom}}

==Prayer training==
Players intending to train Prayer at the Bone Yard are recommended to only bring items they are willing to lose, due to its dangerous location and inhabitants. [[Armour]] and [[food]] can help to mitigate the damage taken from the skeletons until they lose their [[aggressiveness]] after 10 minutes, however it may be beneficial to discard them after this due to their added [[weight]] increasing the player's [[Energy|run energy]] drain rate. In total, there are six big bones spawns and 34 bones spawns at the Bone Yard.

At maximum efficiency, a player can get 9,300 Prayer experience per hour training at the Bone Yard. By doing trips to the [[Chaos altar (Prayer)|Chaos altar]] in the [[Chaos Temple (church)|Chaos Temple]] to the west with big bones, members can increase this to around 18,000 Prayer experience per hour.

===Spawns===
Besides the bones and big bones, the following items also spawn at Bone Yard:
*[[Iron scimitar]]
*[[Skull (item)|Skull]] (3x)
*[[Mind rune]] (6x)
*[[Crossbow]]
